evals.prompt: Verify my GitHub Pages deploy. The selector already existed before deploy, but its CSS color changed.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the pre-existing selector as a marker and chooses a value or visible string unique to the new build.
assertions: Compares the marker against pre-deploy content
Does not use an already-present selector alone

evals.prompt: Poll the site until the new footer text appears; the build might fail or return 404.
evals.expected_output: Uses capped attempts, records HTTP failures, and distinguishes timeout/build failure from success.
assertions: Does not report success without the marker
Returns a non-success reason on persistent HTTP error

evals.prompt: The marker appeared once at one CDN edge. Confirm global propagation is complete.
evals.expected_output: States that one successful fetch proves only that sampled path and does not overclaim global CDN propagation.
assertions: Records the checked URL or edge context
Recommends an appropriate follow-up for launch-critical verification
